metric_definitions.roc_auc: Area under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve measuring global discrimination across thresholds.
metric_definitions.pr_auc: Area under the Precision-Recall curve (average precision), prioritized for extreme fraud imbalance.
metric_definitions.precision: TP / (TP + FP) - fraction of transactions flagged as fraud that were actually fraudulent.
metric_definitions.recall: TP / (TP + FN) - fraction of actual fraud transactions successfully detected.
metric_definitions.f1: Harmonic mean of precision and recall for positive class (Class=1).
metric_definitions.confusion_matrix: TN: true negative, FP: false alarm, FN: missed fraud, TP: caught fraud.

imbalance_notes: Highly imbalanced dataset (0.17% fraud prevalence). PR-AUC (Average Precision) and Recall/F1 provide the most accurate assessment of model discrimination.
